title: Credits on Cancellation, Cuts, Withdrawal, Injury and Trip Cancellation; Credit-Balance Refunds — Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
These are the business office terms of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** for crediting fees when a student leaves an activity and for refunding a credit balance.

**Base of every leaving credit.** Credits for leaving an activity are computed on each fee net of the waiver and cap credits already posted against it, rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up, and are never paid on the late registration fee or on equipment charges.

| Event | Credit | Credit recorded as |
|---|---|---|
| Registration cancelled before clearance | every other fee in full | cancellation credit |
| Student cut at tryouts | the type's cut credit share of every other fee, on the day the roster posts | cut credit |
| Cleared student withdrawn within the type's withdrawal window | the type's withdrawal credit share of the participation fee | withdrawal window credit |
| Cleared student withdrawn later | nothing, except as below | none |
| Season-ending injury documented by a physician injury statement before the midpoint of the season | the type's injury credit share of the participation fee | injury credit |

**Withdrawal window.** The window counts calendar days after the clearance date, the clearance date being day 0; a withdrawal within that many days is inside it.

**Uniform package.** A uniform package is never credited after clearance, because it is ordered in the student's name at clearance.

**Trip cancellation.** A trip cancelled more than the type's deposit-refund days before departure credits the deposit and the balance as a trip cancellation credit; cancelled later but more than the type's balance-due days before departure, it credits the balance only; cancelled later still, it credits nothing.

**Refund of a credit balance.** A credit balance is refunded by district check within the type's credit balance refund days, calendar days, and a refund is issued only on a participation in status withdrawn, cut or completed. That status is read from the district's record of this participation.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical)

- *Cut credit.* A participation fee of 85.00 with a reduced-price waiver credit of 42.50 has a net of 42.50; at a 100 percent cut share the credit is 42.50.
- *Withdrawal window of 10 days.* Cleared on day 0: a withdrawal on day 10 is within the window; one on day 11 is later.
- *Trip, deposit days 30 and balance days 21.* Cancelled 31 days before departure: deposit and balance credited. Cancelled 30 days or 22 days before: balance only. Cancelled 21 days before: nothing.
- *Refund.* A participation in status registered or cleared with a credit balance is not refunded until it is withdrawn, cut or completed.
